headline: Robby Fabbri signs tryout contract with AHL’s Hamilton Hammers
take:
Per Daily Faceoff, Robby Fabbri has signed a professional tryout contract with the AHL's Hamilton Hammers. The report adds that Hamilton also signed Antonio Stranges, a former Dallas Stars prospect, to a tryout deal.

The only team in the data is Dallas, so the Stranges connection is the one worth a look. The Stars are 9-5-2 with 20 points through 16 games, and our numbers say the record is a fair reflection. They have 52.2 percent of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) so far this season, and 52 percent at five-on-five, so they win a bit more of the good looks than their opponents do. They are scoring 4.1 fewer goals than their chances would predict, which says the shooting has lagged. What has carried them is goaltending: 8 goals saved above expected, meaning their goalies have stopped 8 more than an average netminder would have against the same shots. The special teams are solid too, with 0.68 expected power-play goals per game and 0.53 allowed on the penalty kill. A tryout deal in the AHL doesn't change any of that.
